translation.hero_title: Smart Grama Sewa: Your Village, Digitally Connected.
translation.hero_desc: Access essential Grama Niladhari services from the comfort of your home. We're bringing the Grama Niladhari office to your fingertips for a faster, more transparent Sri Lanka.
translation.about_mission_desc: To modernize and digitize traditional local administrative workflows across Sri Lanka. By connecting citizens directly with their local Grama Niladhari division, we reduce long queues, optimize document tracking pipelines, and bring transparency right to your fingertips.
translation.about_citizen_desc: Fill request forms online, manage secure appointment calendars, download pre-filled verified certificate records, and view real-time digital announcement loops.
translation.about_gn_desc: Review citizen requests, process dynamic administrative certificates, manage system availability flags, and keep community spaces safe and updated instantly.
translation.about_desc_1: Smart Grama Sewa is a digital platform developed to bridge the gap between citizens and their local Grama Niladhari (GN) officers — making everyday government services accessible from anywhere, at any time.
translation.about_desc_2: Whether you need to request a certificate, check the status of your application, or simply reach your assigned GN officer, Smart Grama Sewa puts the Grama Niladhari office at your fingertips — no queuing, no paperwork delays.
translation.about_desc_3: Built in partnership with local government authorities, our platform is designed to serve all communities across Sri Lanka in Sinhala, Tamil, and English.
translation.feat_cert_desc: Apply for character, residence, and income certificates online.
translation.feat_book_desc: Schedule meetings with your GN officer without visiting the office.
translation.feat_news_desc: Receive announcements and notices from your local division directly.
translation.feat_comm_desc: Message your assigned GN officer securely through the portal.
